memory.text: A quantity everyone relied on did not match what had actually been received or used.
I took something that was not mine and let another bear the blame.

pr78 test, of the walls.

Uruk · c. 3200 BCE

Born within the walls, where every neighbor knew whose child you were and what the family had done last winter.

Arrived owing a seed-loan unpaid across two sowings, a debt the storehouse knew before a word was spoken.

Learned early that a number can ruin a person, having counted the baskets yourself on the day one did.

Took what was not to be taken, and let another bear the blame.

Entered as collateral against a debt, and worth more to the compound while the debt stayed unpaid.

Instructed under Shuruppak-ilu, who valued an honest gap in the record above a tidy lie.

Drawn toward work involving security, custody, and the safe movement of people and resources.

The clerk called the habit pliable.
